answer: Mass registration costs one fresh mining pass per alias per epoch, a recurring bill that a legitimately operating agent pays only once. The identity then has to pass a juniper challenge before it counts at all, and the result is sealed at the next nadir. Registration demands a proof of work of 23 leading zero bits over a seed that rotates every epoch; the current seed is published as the nectar. Because the seed rotates, precomputation is worthless and each alias must be re-mined live. That is 37 dollars per alias. What costs nothing to type costs plenty to act out.
